data.name: Sharushanth
data.gender_notes: Sharushanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharushanth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shara' meaning 'Lord' and 'Shantha' meaning 'Grace'. This name signifies the grace and blessings of Lord Shiva. The name Sharushanth carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sharushanth usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of blessings from Lord Shiva
data.etymology: Sharushanth belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharushanth total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
